firm_data.firm_description: Katz Melinger PLLC is an experienced and highly respected employment law, civil litigation and business transactions firm in New York. Our attorneys take the time to listen to and build real connections with everyone we represent, striving to provide an honest assessment of the legal and practical aspects of each client's needs.
notable_facts: The firm represents employees in New York and New Jersey in employment law matters.
The firm also represents businesses and commercial creditors in commercial collections and judgment enforcement matters in NY/NJ.

email.subject: AI for Katz Melinger PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kenneth,

Since founding Katz Melinger in 2012, you've built a respected practice across employment law, civil litigation, and commercial collections. That combination demands precision and client trust above all else.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
